characters.summary: Kingsley Shacklebolt is an elite Auror and high-ranking member of the Order of the Phoenix. He fights with powerful combat magic, excellent dueling skills against multiple opponents, and later becomes Minister for Magic.
limitations: Relies on standard human physical capabilities outside of magical casting.

sources.supports: Auror status, combat feats, leadership role in the Order of the Phoenix

feats.claim: Dueled simultaneously against multiple Death Eaters at the Department of Mysteries and later at the Battle of Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix / Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Battle of the Department of Mysteries
notableResults.note: Fought alongside other Order members against Voldemort's forces.

campaignTags.claim: Skilled wizard who casts a wide variety of combat and defensive spells.

unknowns: Exact wand core and wood specifications are not prominently featured in the main narrative.

characters.summary: Kreacher is a house-elf bound to the Noble and Most Ancient House of Black and later Harry Potter. He possesses innate house-elf magic capable of bypassing standard wizarding restrictions and can teleport without a wand.

mechanisms: Innate magical resistance unique to house-elves

weaknesses: Bound to obey master commands unless specifically freed or manipulated through loopholes.
limitations: Subject to orders from those he recognizes as masters.

sources.supports: House-elf magic capabilities, loyalty, combat role during the Battle of Hogwarts

feats.claim: Led Hogwarts house-elves in the Battle of Hogwarts against Voldemort's forces.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.note: Led the house-elf charge wielding kitchen knives.

campaignTags.claim: House-elves can magically transport themselves and others without wands.
Possesses potent innate magical abilities distinct from human wizardry.

unknowns: Full extent of house-elf magic capabilities beyond domestic and teleportation feats.

characters.summary: Lavender Brown is a student at Hogwarts and a member of Dumbledore's Army. She fights using standard student-level charms and curses.
weaknesses: Standard human physical and magical limits.
limitations: Lacks advanced combat training or notable dueling achievements.

sources.supports: Dumbledore's Army membership, fate during the Battle of Hogwarts

feats.claim: Practiced defensive spells as part of Dumbledore's Army under Harry Potter's instruction.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Attacked during the Battle of Hogwarts and severely injured.

campaignTags.claim: Hogwarts student trained in basic spellcasting.

unknowns: Exact canonical status regarding survival after the werewolf attack in the book versus film.

limitations: No extraordinary combat feats recorded outside standard wizarding conflicts.

feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.note: Fought alongside defenders to protect the school.

campaignTags.claim: Qualified wizard capable of combat magic.

unknowns: Full roster of specific spells mastered.

characters.summary: Leta Lestrange is a powerful witch of the Lestrange family and a Ministry of Magic employee. She is proficient in dark and defensive arts, utilizing sophisticated spellwork in high-stakes confrontations.

sources.supports: Ministry employment, magical proficiency, confrontation with Grindelwald

feats.claim: Mounted a diversion against Gellert Grindelwald's followers to allow allies to escape.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald

notableResults.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
notableResults.note: Killed by Grindelwald's blue protective/destructive fire spell after a brief confrontation.

campaignTags.claim: Skilled witch capable of complex spellcasting.

unknowns: Full range of spells mastered during her time at Hogwarts and the British Ministry.

characters.summary: Lily Potter was a highly accomplished witch known for her proficiency in charms and potion-making. Her defining combat legacy is the ancient protective love sacrifice that shielded Harry Potter.
limitations: Could not overpower Lord Voldemort directly in a standard duel without preparation.

sources.supports: Prefect and Head Girl status, skill in magic, sacrificial protection

feats.claim: Created a lasting ancient protective barrier through her deliberate sacrifice protecting infant Harry.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

notableResults.note: Killed by Voldemort, but her sacrifice successfully protected her son.

campaignTags.claim: Talented witch proficient in various branches of magic.

unknowns: Complete extent of her combat capabilities outside of academic excellence and Order resistance work.

characters.summary: Lord Voldemort is regarded as one of the most powerful and dangerous dark wizards in history. He excels in deadly curses, non-verbal magic, flying without a broom, and commanding dark creatures.
limitations: Relies on his wand or complex ritualistic magic for major offensive feats when disembodied.

sources.supports: Dark magic mastery, flight without support, duel history, Horcruxes

feats.claim: Fought Dumbledore to a near stalemate in the Ministry atrium using diverse elemental and lethal curses.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Drawn duel in the Ministry of Magic before Dumbledore gained the upper hand with assistance.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Killed Snape to attempt mastery of the Elder Wand.

campaignTags.claim: Master of virtually all forms of offensive and defensive wizarding magic.
Can fly unsupported through the air without a broom or mechanical aid.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how he achieved unsupported flight without a broom.

characters.summary: Lord Voldemort wielding the Elder Wand possesses maximum possible magical amplification, enhancing his casting potency and destructive output.
weaknesses: Flawed allegiance mechanics of the Elder Wand if mastered by an opponent.
limitations: Wand allegiance can refuse to harm its true master.
characters.formDifferences: Wields the Elder Wand, which significantly amplifies his spellcasting power, though ownership allegiance backfires against Harry Potter.

sources.supports: The Elder Wand's immense power amplification and history with Voldemort

feats.claim: Generated a massive magical shockwave that knocked down multiple combatants simultaneously during the Battle of Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: The Elder Wand refused to kill its true master, causing Voldemort's killing curse to rebound.

campaignTags.claim: Wields the most powerful wand in existence to amplify dark magic.

unknowns: Whether the wand's power boost could permanently override fundamental laws of magic.
